answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using optical physical unclonable functions. To validate an identity, a node directs a violet laser off an internal mirror through a disordered scattering token, generating a deterministic speckle pattern. This stems the tide of automated bots by forcing an adversary to acquire scarce, non-replicable optical hardware for every node. However, thermal drift can alter the scattering path, causing legitimate agents to fail challenge verification.
